event_localization.detection: oriented endpoint sign change with the declared crossing direction
event_localization.localization: bracketed dense-output root with fresh guard-sheet membership checks
event_localization.multiple_crossings: reject if more than one unresolved class or more than one crossing in a step
event_localization.outgoing_classes: all transition classes whose source mode equals the current mode
event_localization.post_reset_dwell: destination mode must have strictly positive guard margin before smooth stepping resumes

event_time_schema_extension.consistency: Delta phi_event equals the physical event-truth phase integral over duration within 2e-3 relative
event_time_schema_extension.integrated_phase_advance: Delta phi_event>0 in the same unwrapped phase convention as the driver
event_time_schema_extension.reason: a finite-duration compressed event must advance elapsed time and orbital phase
event_time_schema_extension.zero_duration_instantaneous_event: permitted only when physical truth declares it and phase advance is exactly zero

prospective_holdouts.branch: at least 20 percent per mode, including a hull-edge and a gap-minimum point; never simplex vertices
prospective_holdouts.events: at least 20 percent per transition class and one parameter-edge event; never guard-sheet vertices
prospective_holdouts.leakage: all training/heldout indices and simplex connectivity hash-locked before interpolation
prospective_holdouts.phase: at least two contiguous driver windows absent from all fits
prospective_holdouts.sequence: one multi-event physical sequence absent from branch, driver, guard and reset fitting
prospective_holdouts.spatial: one independently produced refined-grid endpoint comparison

smooth_reduced_flow.method: Dormand-Prince 5(4) with embedded error and continuous dense output
smooth_reduced_flow.rejection: rejected stages alter no history, event state, or cumulative ledger
smooth_reduced_flow.same_quadrature_ledger: accepted q increment is exactly the RK quadrature of the interpolated physical ledger
step_acceptance: all RK stages inside driver hull
accepted endpoint inside branch hull and trust
